Visited the Passport Seva Kendra at Andheri East, Mumbai today for my passport renewal, and overall it was a smooth experience.

The entire process at Passport Seva Kendra Andheri East was well managed:

Movement between counters A, B, and C was seamless. Staff at most counters were professional and efficient. The security guard was polite and helpful.

Another suggestion: the toilets need better maintenance. Having a dedicated cleaner stationed there would improve hygiene standards significantly.

For anyone going for renewal  without any changes, it’s not complicated at all. I carried:

Voter ID

PAN Card

Aadhaar (A4 printed version with verified signature, not just the smart card)

Original passport + photocopies of first and last two pages
All self attested..
They only asked me for the Voter ID & my passport during the process. No one asked for DigiLocker or any digital documents.

Overall, apart from one staff interaction and the restroom cleanliness, it was a very good and efficient experience.
All officers were kind n helpful .Thank you

Rating as of 15/4/26.
1 star reduced due to C1 counter lady officer attitude towards applicants. She doesn't have manners to talk with people, big thumbs down for her👎.

• At the entry security guard checks appointment letter or mobile copy and allow inside only who's appointment is.
• At security check post which is inside building, 2 guards verify appointment letter, all xerox copies along with original and allow only applicants inside.
• At reception they verify all the documents xerox set, original and ask to get token from scanner machine, which is nearby. Don't expect kindness here from reception executives as rush might kill their sympathy. You will get token from reception.
• Note: there are three counters A, B and C, each counter has different checks.
• You need to enter into counter A ZONE. At Counter A, they asks us to verify application form on monitor. They click photograph from their DSLR, you can see your clicked photo live. Finger scanner done later, sign on each xerox copies. Show original here as well. Then they pull us to B counter.
• You have to go at B counter ZONE. There are multiple subcounters are there B1, B2, B3, B4. Your token number and B sub counter will display on screen, wait for your for your turn. At B counters again all copies are checked. But key point here is they ask for digilocker and link Adhar with it. Then they route you to last counter i.e. C.
• After B counter verification you have to wait in the same B counter zone and wait for your token and C sub counter to be displayed on same screen.
• Once your token code and C sub counter displays on screen, you have to walk a way at C counter ZONE. Note, in C counter ZONE there are 4 subcounters C1, C2, C3, C3 are there, your token code and C sub counter will display.
• At C subcounters, it is one of the fastest process as compared to A and B. Here they closely look at your application print, xerox copies and all original. Then they grant application in the system. Note, stamp is not required for fresh passport application. You have to walk towards exist door which is on the right side.
• After C counter ZONE verification are done. You will get SMS and email about your application process, tracking ID and police verification.

Furthermore, I had to pay an additional 1,000 INR directly to an RTO vendor for an HSRP prerequisite, and was asked to re-submit documents I had already provided.
- Final Complacency: Even after the online work was complete (Feb 2026) and I paid the final balance (March 3, 2026), the hard copy documents were delayed. It took three extremely frustrated follow-up emails in late March to finally get the tracking number.
This service demonstrated a complete lack of urgency and professionalism. Do not rely on ItzEazy for time-sensitive or "premium" document services.

featured_reviews.name: sandeep brahmawar
featured_reviews.review_text:
ITseazy Is a Complete Scam – Dishonest, Incompetent, and Exploitative

My experience with ITseazy has been one of the worst service experiences of my life. Caution for an agent called Ms Tina who gives false information and What they advertise as an “easy” process is actually a slow, dishonest, and exploitative trap designed to extract money from customers while delivering misery in return.

I approached ITseazy for a duplicate Registration Certificate (RC) for my 4-wheeler. They confidently quoted ₹4,000, took the entire amount upfront, and promised completion within 30 days. That promise turned out to be an outright lie.

Instead of 30 days, the process dragged on for 90+ days. The reason? They lost my documents. Not once, but completely—forcing me to resubmit paperwork and restart the entire process. This level of negligence is shocking for a company claiming to handle official government documentation. There was zero ownership of their mistake, no apology, and no urgency—just endless follow-ups from my side.

After three months of frustration, delays, and mental harassment, when the RC was finally issued by the RTO, ITseazy stooped even lower. They demanded additional money to dispatch the RC to my address, holding my document hostage unless I paid more. This was never transparently communicated upfront. Taking full payment in advance and then asking for more money at the final stage is nothing short of extortionary behavior.

This company thrives on false timelines, poor accountability, lost paperwork, and last-minute money demands, knowing that customers are helpless once their documents are stuck in the system. It feels like a deliberate strategy rather than an accident.

ITseazy wasted three months of my time, caused immense stress, and showed complete contempt for customer trust. I am initiating legal action through the consumer court and will ensure my experience is publicly documented on every review platform possible so others are not fooled by their marketing.

If you are considering ITseazy, understand this clearly:
They take your money first, delay endlessly, lose documents, and then ask for more money.

Avoid this company at all costs unless you enjoy being ignored, misled, and financially squeezed.

⭐ Rating: 1/5 — ITseazy deserves public scrutiny, not customers.
